tableLines.line: ⛓️ Thornfield doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A man, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

⬢ SYSTEM: "One clarification, scholar: linking codices sharpens MY eyes. Ability slots grow from YOUR neural integration — 19/100, holding 1 slot (next at 20). Discover, practice, survive — let the interface learn you."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)
Somchai: "a tall grass with a dense bottle-brush grain head is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Patrick: "Bitter Leaf is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
🔇 The birds have gone quiet. Even the crickets. The woods are holding their breath.
Nikolai: "Wild Onion is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
Adriano: "Curry Leaf is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 9,000 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Grace.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
With Haven grieving, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table. Tribute rises to 13,500 kcal/week. Grief is leverage, and they know it. The link holds — it was never with one person.
🧳 Stonebridge has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

With Haven grieving again, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 13,500 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.

FUSION REACTOR: the pellet goes in — properly, inside you. A warm hum starts behind your ribs and settles. You will never be hungry again. One reactor per world: yours. It does not come out. (The System is DELIGHTED. That should worry you.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

The little star inside Robin goes quiet — and wakes up inside Deniz. Robin never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Deniz will never be hungry again while it hums, and Robin is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
Brian: "Pupunha (Peach Palm) is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

With Haven grieving again, Thornfield installs their own speaker at the table — and reaches for the grief card once more. The table has heard it before: the grief card is spent. Tribute stays at 13,500 kcal/week. The link holds — it was never with one person.
A rider says in The Red Table you're "the one who makes deals hold." Nobody remembers when that started being true.
